`get_user_profile` was handing back an account id that nothing else accepts. No
tool was added or removed — the server still declares 109.

## The wrong id

Garmin keeps two numbers on a profile, and the tool returned the one you cannot
use:

```
id        = 418479350   returned by the tool, accepted by nothing
profileId = 124115002   used by everything, not returned
```

`profileId` is the number the rest of your data is filed under. It is the
`ownerId` on every activity and the `userProfilePK` on your sleep, HRV and other
wellness records. `id` is a separate internal identifier that appears nowhere
else.

The tool built its answer from a fixed list of five fields, and `profileId` was
not on it. So asking for your account id gave you the one number that matches
nothing, with no way to reach the one that matches everything.

Both are returned now, and the tool says which is which.

This came to light while testing against the gear service, which refuses `id`
outright: *"Cannot create a gear for another user."*

## Install

Download `garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb` and open it with Claude Desktop, or drag it onto
Settings → Extensions. Verify the download first:

```
sha256sum -c garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb.sha256
```

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/sedoglia/garmin-mcp-ts/compare/v4.5.1...v4.5.2
